equations.reading: Z=sum_lambda registered X(lambda); sum notation for point sets does not specify duplicate removal or per-point calibrated full spectra.
For each 3D point, histogram Euclidean distances to all other points; bins based on that point maximum distance divided into n equal intervals. n not numerically specified.

Normalize histogram by total count. Full identical geometry under scale/rotation/translation yields scale-invariant distance-bin statistics; count normalization alone does not prove invariance to arbitrary partial overlap or changed point sampling.
Correlation coefficient of normalized histograms; numerator writes H_y_i while denominator/explanations refer H_y_j. Retain original indexing discrepancy; no executable implementation verified.

Correspondence printed argmax_j ||C(x_i,y_j)||; for scalar this could select absolute correlation. No mutual/one-to-one matching, flat histogram zero-variance handling or exact implementation established.
Printed min sum ||R(y_i)+T-x_i|| without squared norm or explicit scale, despite text invoking quaternion scale recovery. Do not rewrite as a proved scaled least-squares objective.

Neighbor chain product from i=lambda toK of T_(i,i+1) formally includes edgeK→K+1 although anchorK is stated; matrix multiplication order/inverse case not specified. This is the discussed drift-prone alternative, not necessarily the selected merge strategy.
Mean Euclidean distance (sum square roots divided by correspondence count), not mean squared error. Coordinate units/scale normalization and independent ground-truth metric not specified.

Row minimum of asymmetric pairwise mean-distance matrix; graph nodes merged and costs recomputed iteratively. Text says TSP-like minimum path but gives greedy divide-and-conquer/Algorithm1, no optimality proof or tie/conflict resolution.

algorithmBoundary: Algorithm1 is text pseudocode, not standalone architecture figure or executable source. Histogram bins, MSS/inlier threshold, stopping count, seeds, feature extraction/dense settings and hardware absent.
